claims.claim: BCBS's Basel III monitoring shows stable capital
claims.reason: S1 says Basel III risk-based capital and leverage ratios stayed stable for large internationally active banks as of end-2025.
S1: the weighted average LCR rose to 136.6% for Group 1 banks.
S1: the weighted average NSFR fell slightly to 123.3% for Group 1 banks.

claims.claim: Fed's Bowman flags final stress-test revisions soon
claims.reason: In her 18 Sept 2026 speech, Bowman said: 'In the coming weeks, the Federal Reserve Board will consider final revisions to the Board's stress testing framework.'

claims.claim: UBS capital dispute with Swiss minister continues
claims.reason: S3 (22 Sept 2026) reports that Finance Minister Keller-Sutter and UBS CEO Ermotti defended their opposing views ahead of the capital decision, which clearly implies the dispute is still going on.
